# P09.1: finite PHPDoc precision with runtime API/schema preservation

Source: [JSON](../../decisions/D126.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Date

2026-10-06

## Status

accepted

## Question

How to make foundation typing precise while keeping runtime API/schema compatible?

## Context

P09.1 real diagnostics found inaccurate serialized PHPDoc and untyped trust boundaries. Current Roave core check has no new unapproved break; API report identifies exactly six PHPDoc-only symbol deltas. P09.1 rules require a precise decision, changelog and current API carrier for any public delta. D72 delegates reversible technical decisions within authorized quality scope.

## Decision

Approve only truthful PHPDoc refinements and validated deserialization in the six named core types: CompiledModule, CompiledRegistry, EntityField, EntityDefinition, FieldDefinition and ModuleManifest. Keep all native public signatures, valid serialized values (including arbitrary JSON feature flag payloads), schema/migration bytes, version/channel metadata and existing BC base/approvals unchanged. Register the finite documentation delta in core CHANGELOG and regenerate the existing API manifest/reference from actual source; no new public symbol or method is admitted. Extend P09.1 exact write scope BEFORE touching those three existing generated/documentation paths, preserving original pre and freezing a linked extension against unchanged pre hashes.

## Rationale

A zero-baseline result must describe real producer/consumer values and validate raw serialized inputs, rather than falsify types or suppress diagnostics. Finite PHPDoc contract precision is explicitly declared under the existing item rule; runtime compatibility remains acceptance-bound.

## Consequences

- Allowed documentation-only symbols: CoreX\Modules\Data\ModuleManifest, CoreX\Modules\Data\EntityField, CoreX\Modules\Data\CompiledModule, CoreX\Modules\Data\EntityDefinition, CoreX\Modules\Data\CompiledRegistry, CoreX\Modules\Data\FieldDefinition
- Mandatory root/core/access-azguard analysis, BC/API/schema/Golden, SQLite/PG, negative controls and fixed mutations remain unchanged.
- Scope extension only packages/core/CHANGELOG.md, packages/core/resources/contracts/php-api.json, docs/reference/public-api.md; new before hashes must match original pre inventory and current unchanged files. No retrospective unrelated allowance.
- Revert/fix any accidental valid-input behavior change; add feature flag scalar/list round-trip and malformed serialized payload tests. Independent final review remains P09.8; no additional review/grant/publication.

## Applies to

- P09.1
